frontmatter.title: S3.2.1.4 Observability
when_to_use: evaluating runtime visibility of system behavior
auditing whether observability is built into the code rather than bolted on
designing UI feedback that surfaces meaningful state
threats: opaque systems that depend on external tooling alone
log entries lacking sufficient context for incident analysis
frontmatter.summary: The degree to which the internal state of a system can be inferred from its external outputs. Achieved through code-level instrumentation: structured logging, monitoring, instrumentation, and UI feedback.
